what: A rhythm synthesis groovebox: 69 synthesized drum and synth models (59 original), a deep sequencer with locks, ties, probability, cycles and ratchets, plus 23 chainable effects. A line generator writes in key; Autopilot evolves your tracks endlessly. Stutter, macros, snap-back controls, sampler, granular, DAW plugins. Built for the FM-1, playable in your browser.
author: PING AUDIO
